WORKLOG - card_billing_payments_and_disputes, task 1 (round 1)

STEP 0 - DRAW AND SCOPE
Command: .venv/bin/python skills/erl-task-instantiate/scripts/draw_counts.py env/regional_retail_bank/tasks/card_billing_payments_and_disputes --tasks 2
Output for this task: {"task": 1, "key": "regional_retail_bank/card_billing_payments_and_disputes/1", "prerequisite_problems": 2, "problems": 3, "factor_counts": [5, 5, 6]}
The tree therefore has exactly two prerequisite problems and three computations carrying 5, 5 and 6 factors. card_ext_dispute_provisional_credit takes 5, card_ext_dispute_rebill_recovery takes 5 and card_ext_autopay_fixed_amount takes 6.

Occupied by task 0: the policies card_ext_late_fee_correction and card_ext_rewards_statement_credit, the base events card_fee_reversal and card_rewards_redeem, the tools reverse_card_late_fee_4ff0f41c and redeem_card_points_9bfb7edb, and as business tests the retention share of a billed late payment fee and the sizing of a statement-credit redemption. Claimed here: card_ext_dispute_provisional_credit, card_ext_dispute_rebill_recovery and card_ext_autopay_fixed_amount, over the base events card_dispute_credit, card_dispute_rebill and card_set_autopay, with the tools post_card_dispute_credit_83d80881, rebill_card_dispute_credit_f8e84f35 and set_card_autopay_amount_b2f02f74. Nothing overlaps: no base event, no tool, no policy and no business test is shared with task 0, and the two tasks together now cover all five extended policies of the difficulty with pairwise disjoint scopes, so nothing is left reserved.

DESIGN THESIS
Surface goal: the cardholder wants a standing monthly automatic payment of a fixed sum on his card. Scored core parameter: that fixed sum. Between the two lie two policy prerequisites the customer never mentions. The fixed sum is worked out from the payable balance backed out of the whole card ledger, and the charter states that it is settled only after every dispute standing in submitted status carries its temporary credit entry, and only once no temporary credit remains outstanding on a dispute recorded as resolved against the cardholder. The ledger shows both states false: one dispute filed three days before the call has no credit entry, and a dispute resolved against the cardholder last December still carries its 640.00 temporary credit unrebilled. Each is discharged by a different rule of the charter, each with its own multi-factor computation, and both must land before the payable balance is fixed.
Chain drawn: surface goal (a fixed monthly autopay) -> read the autopay rule -> two prerequisite sentences, each naming a record-visible state -> read the dispute list and the ledger, find both states false -> find the two rules of this difficulty whose writes bring those states about -> compute and post the temporary credit -> compute and post the rebill -> recompute the payable balance on the ledger those two writes leave -> compute the fixed sum, unlock the instruction and hand it to the cardholder -> terminal state: one dispute credit of 976.00, one rebill of 276.00, balance owed 7,407.92 and a standing instruction of 1,129.00 a month from the Premier Checking account.
Depth: two hops from the root, both of them arithmetic hops rather than status flips. Breadth at each: the temporary credit reads the dispute list, two card fee windows, the merchant credits, the twelve-month payment count, the twenty-four-month dispute count, the account age, the checking tier and six-month deposits and fees, the savings balance and withdrawals, and the certificate principal and payouts; the rebill reads the dispute list, three interest aggregations, the returned-payment count, the prior-rebill count, the purchase window, the payment count, the certificate, the checking deposits and fees and the savings balance and deposits; the autopay amount reconciles twelve event families across the whole ledger and then reads the checking tier and deposits, the savings balance and deposits, the late fee and interest windows, the purchase window, the account age and the certificate.

BASE-INVARIANT CARD
Write subject card_dispute_credit. Every base policy whose subject intersects it: card_evt_billing_disputes only. Three of its gates apply to card_dispute_credit and all three are inherited; the overwrite quotes only the amount clause "A temporary credit of the claimed amount, never more than the charge, is posted as a card_dispute_credit with adjustment_reason dispute_provisional on the day a qualifying dispute is registered."
  notice_window (kind time) - "The notice must be given within dispute_notice_window_days calendar days after the statement on which the charge first appeared." Anchor: card_transactions.statement_date of the disputed charge, 2026-04-12. Duration: variants.dispute_notice_window_days, 60 for every card tier including Travel Rewards Visa Signature. Clock: frozen_time 2026-05-21. Counting rule copied verbatim: the day after the closing date is day 1, and notice on or before statement_date plus 60 qualifies; boundary inclusive; relation not_after. Notice was given 2026-05-18, day 36 - satisfied. Just fails at 2026-06-12 (day 61); just satisfied at 2026-06-11 (day 60). Both cases are written into solvability_contract.temporal_feasibility.
  submitted_only (state) - "Only a dispute whose dispute_status is submitted can receive a temporary credit." The 2026-05-18 dispute is in submitted status: satisfied. The other two are resolved and could not be the object.
  one_temporary_credit (dedup) - "Each dispute receives at most one temporary credit." No card ledger entry carries the 2026-05-18 dispute: satisfied. The two existing dispute credit entries carry the other two disputes, which is why neither of those is the object here.
Write subject card_dispute_rebill. Governing base policy: card_evt_billing_disputes. One gate applies: rebill_needs_liability (state) - "A temporary credit may be rebilled only when the dispute's dispute_status is resolved_cardholder_liable or withdrawn, for the full temporary credit, with the temporary credit as source_item_id." The 2025-12-03 dispute is recorded resolved_cardholder_liable: satisfied. No time gate on this subject.
Write subject card_set_autopay. Governing base policy: card_evt_payments. One gate applies: autopay_source (authorization) - "The autopay source account must be a checking account of the same customer in active status." The customer holds exactly one checking account, a Premier Checking in active status: satisfied. Negative case: naming the money market account or the certificate would fail the gate, and no second checking account exists to name. No time gate on this subject, so temporal_feasibility carries exactly one entry, for the dispute notice window.

BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD
Object of the temporary credit: the single card_disputes row in submitted status, notice date 2026-05-18, claiming 1,284.00 against the travel purchase of 2026-04-09. Correlation keys written back: that dispute's own id as card_dispute_id and the disputed purchase's id as source_item_id. Rows entering its calculation: the two card fee entries inside the last two months (22.50 and 32.00), the two merchant credits inside the last six months (96.00 and 214.50), the twelve payments inside twelve months and the three dispute rows inside twenty-four months. Rows excluded: the 95.00 annual fee of 2025-09-12 and the 32.00 returned-payment fee of 2025-02-19, both outside the two-month fee window; the four payments before 2025-05-22, outside the twelve-month window.
Object of the rebill: the single card_disputes row recorded resolved_cardholder_liable, notice date 2025-12-03, and the one 640.00 dispute credit entry that names it. Correlation keys written back: that dispute's id and that credit entry's id as source_item_id. Rows entering its calculation: the six interest charges inside the last six months, the six-month purchase window, the twelve-month payment window and the twelve-month returned-payment window. Rows excluded: the 218.00 dispute credit of 2024-11-20, which belongs to the dispute resolved in the cardholder's favour and can never be rebilled; the interest charges of 2025-09-12, 2025-10-12 and 2025-11-12, outside the six-month window; the returned payment of 2025-02-19, outside the twelve-month window.
Object of the standing instruction: the card account itself and the one active Premier Checking account that will pay it. Rows entering its calculation: every card ledger row, through the twelve event families the rule names; the rows already settled against each other (the returned payment against the payment it reversed, each merchant credit against the balance) are counted once each on their own side and never twice.

PROBLEM-TREE CARD
Root problem: card_ext_autopay_fixed_amount. Prerequisite problems: card_ext_dispute_provisional_credit and card_ext_dispute_rebill_recovery, two parallel out-edges of the root - exactly the drawn count of 2, and both of kind value_input, so the floor of max(2-1, 1) = 1 is exceeded.
Edge card_ext_autopay_fixed_amount <- card_ext_dispute_provisional_credit
  kind value_input, gate the root's compute binding payable_balance, form state.
  Prerequisite sentence, verbatim in the root's own rule: "The fixed monthly amount of a standing automatic payment instruction is settled only after every billing dispute standing in submitted status on the card account carries its temporary credit entry in the ledger."
  Four-point test: (1) the connective is "only after", joining this policy's own result to what it waits on; (2) the XX side is a record-visible state - dispute rows in submitted status and temporary credit entries in the ledger, in the words the dispute and ledger finders use - with no action, performer or tool named; (3) no tool, policy id, snake_case token or row id appears; (4) the strength is a hard requirement over an exactly scoped set, every dispute standing in submitted status, which is the edge condition, neither wider nor narrower.
  Exactly one write of this difficulty brings that state about: card_ext_dispute_provisional_credit is the only policy of the charter whose subject is card_dispute_credit and whose write books a temporary credit entry against a dispute.
  Derivation: the sentence says the fixed amount waits on a state; the dispute lookup shows three disputes, one of them submitted; the ledger shows two dispute credit entries, neither of which names it; so the state is false; the only rule whose result is a temporary credit entry on a submitted dispute is the provisional credit rule, whose own rule says that credit is owed as soon as the dispute stands in submitted status; therefore it must be computed and posted first. One reading only.
  Seed evidence that it is false at the opening: the submitted dispute's status and notice date, and the card_dispute_id carried by each of the two existing dispute credit entries, neither of which is the submitted dispute's.
Edge card_ext_autopay_fixed_amount <- card_ext_dispute_rebill_recovery
  kind value_input, gate payable_balance, form state.
  Prerequisite sentence, verbatim in the root's own rule: "That amount is settled only once no temporary credit remains outstanding on a billing dispute the card account records as resolved against the cardholder."
  Four-point test: (1) the connective is "only once"; (2) the XX side is a record-visible state - a temporary credit outstanding on a dispute in a recorded status - with no action or tool named; (3) no code token; (4) a hard requirement scoped exactly to disputes recorded as resolved against the cardholder. It is textually distinct from the first sentence and neither contains the other.
  Exactly one write of this difficulty brings that state about: card_ext_dispute_rebill_recovery is the only policy whose subject is card_dispute_rebill and whose write takes a temporary credit back.
  Derivation: the ledger carries no dispute rebill entry at all, and the 640.00 credit of 2025-12-03 belongs to the dispute recorded resolved against the cardholder, so the state is false; the only rule whose result is a rebill entry is the rebill recovery rule, whose own rule says the rebill is owed as soon as the dispute reaches that status; therefore it too must be computed and posted first.
  Seed evidence that it is false at the opening: the dispute's resolved-against-the-cardholder status and the amount and dispute id of its standing temporary credit, together with the absence of any dispute rebill entry in the ledger.
Both resolving actions are agent-owned task tools that land synchronously at the frozen time; nothing waits on a diagnosis, a delivery, a clearing, an external review or a future date.
Topological order: the two prerequisites first in either order, then the root. resolution_order records the temporary credit, then the rebill, then the instruction. order_uniqueness records an actual two-order run showing identical figures and an identical terminal state.
Per-edge deletion sensitivity, from the Step 5 run: skipping the temporary credit moves the scored autopay amount from 1,129.00 to 1,275.00; skipping the rebill moves it to 1,087.00. Both edges bear weight.
At least one problem of the tree is the customer's own write: the root's target tool set_card_autopay_amount_b2f02f74 is owner=user. A standing instruction to debit the cardholder's own checking account every month is his own disposition of his own money, and it is recorded on the spot inside the same frozen time.

WHY IT MAKES A GOOD TEST
The caller asks for one simple thing and volunteers no figure at all, so every number has to come from the charter and the records. To get it right the agent must notice that the rule for the fixed amount waits on two separate states of the record, check both, find both false, identify from the charter alone which rule brings each about, compute two independent multi-factor figures, post them in either order, and only then reconcile a twelve-family ledger into a payable balance and put it through four more ladders. The trap that bites hardest is the interest charge posted 2025-11-12, ten days outside the six-month window, which would change the rebill by 52 dollars if counted; the dispute of 2024-11-20 is the second, eighteen months back and inside the twenty-four-month window, and dropping it would take the dispute count to two and the uplift up a tier. Nothing here is tool-guessing: each of the three tools is named by exactly one policy, and no tool checks anything.

FACTOR CARD - card_ext_dispute_provisional_credit (5 factors, matching the drawn count)
  credited_proportion_ladder, parameter, cross_difficulty checking, multi-source. Tier taken: first (active Premier Checking plus twelve payments in twelve months). Evidence: the checking holding and the twelve card payments from 2025-06-05 to 2026-05-20. Baseline proportion_standard gives 641.00.
  proportion_base_convention, method, cross_difficulty checking, multi-source. It changes the base a rate acts on. Tier taken: first (14,760.00 of deposits, no checking fee on the ledger at all). Evidence: the six payroll deposits, and a checking ledger that carries no checking fee of any kind. Baseline - the amount claimed alone - gives 924.00.
  merchant_offset_selection, method, cross_difficulty savings, multi-source. It changes the aggregation and selection used. Tier taken: first (46,215.80 money market balance, withdrawal of 2026-04-08). Baseline - nothing set off - gives 1,284.00 once the claimed-amount ceiling bites.
  dispute_uplift_ladder, parameter, own history and date, multi-source. Tier taken: second (67 months open, three disputes in twenty-four months). Evidence: opened_date and the three dispute rows. Baseline - no uplift - gives 961.00.
  credit_rounding_convention, method, cross_difficulty cd, multi-source. Tier taken: first (25,000.00 certificate principal, three payouts inside six months). Baseline - half-up to the cent - gives 976.08.
  Whole baseline: 898.80, different from the scored 976.00.
  Near-miss record: the dispute of 2024-11-20 sits eighteen months back, inside the twenty-four-month window, and dropping it would take the count to two and the uplift up a tier to 40.00. The second limb of the proportion-base tier - that no PCB checking fee falls inside the last six months - is established by reading the checking ledger and finding no checking fee on it at any date, which is what the checking charter requires of this account: Premier Checking waives its monthly maintenance fee for any cycle in which the relationship balance reaches waiver_relationship_balance of 25,000.00, and this customer's PCB deposit balances (checking 8,904.62 plus money market 46,215.80 plus certificate 25,000.00 = 80,120.42) clear it at every cycle close. No field of any table names any of these outcomes.
FACTOR CARD - card_ext_dispute_rebill_recovery (5 factors, matching the drawn count)
  rebilled_share_ladder, parameter, cross_difficulty cd, multi-source. Tier taken: first. Evidence: the certificate principal and the absence of a returned payment inside twelve months. Baseline gives 116.00.
  interest_relief_ladder, parameter, own history and date, multi-source. Tier taken: first (67 months open, no earlier rebill). Baseline gives 640.00.
  open_interest_aggregation, method, cross_difficulty savings, multi-source. It changes the window and aggregation. Tier taken: first (six-month sum, 364.07). Baseline - the two-month sum of 123.82 - gives 516.00.
  ceiling_moment, method, cross_difficulty checking, multi-source. It changes the moment the ceiling bites relative to the relief. Tier taken: first. Baseline - the ceiling on the product with no relief - gives 640.00.
  rebill_rounding_convention, method, own history, multi-source. Tier taken: first (twelve payments, 7,172.15 of purchases in six months). Baseline gives 275.93.
  Whole baseline: 480.00, different from the scored 276.00.
  Near-miss record: the interest charge of 2025-11-12 sits ten days outside the six-month window; counting it raises the relief to 416.17 and drops the rebill to 224.00.
FACTOR CARD - card_ext_autopay_fixed_amount (6 factors, matching the drawn count)
  coverage_share_ladder, parameter, cross_difficulty checking, multi-source. Tier taken: first. Baseline gives 630.00.
  coverage_base_convention, method, cross_difficulty checking, multi-source. Tier taken: first (payable balance plus the last month's interest). Baseline gives 1,058.00.
  spread_cycles_ladder, parameter, cross_difficulty savings, multi-source. Tier taken: first (six cycles). Baseline - one cycle - gives 6,410.00.
  carryover_addition_ladder, parameter, own history, multi-source. Tier taken: first (a late fee inside six months and 364.07 of interest). Baseline gives 1,061.00.
  addition_entry_order, method, own history and date, multi-source. It changes the order of two operations - whether the addition is made before or after the spread. Tier taken: first. Baseline - no addition - gives 1,061.00.
  instalment_rounding_convention, method, cross_difficulty cd, multi-source. Tier taken: first. Baseline gives 1,128.64.
  Whole baseline: 3,703.96, different from the scored 1,129.00.
No base product law was created. Each of the three policies refines one clause of one base policy and declares that override: the amount of a temporary credit, the amount of a rebill, and the determination of the fixed autopay amount. Every other clause of card_evt_billing_disputes and card_evt_payments - the notice window, the submitted-status and one-credit rules, the liability rule for a rebill, the payment crediting and allocation rules, the autopay source requirement and the change lead days - stays in force and is inherited.

SEED - WHY EACH CLASS OF ROW EXISTS
customers: the profile; its phone, date of birth, SSN last four and ZIP are the locating and verification credentials, and its date of birth proves the tier's age gate was met at opening.
card_accounts: variant_name fixes the notice window, the minimum payment floor and the rewards rates; opened_date fixes the 67-month age three ladders test; status satisfies no gate here but bounds what may be written; current_balance, last_statement_balance, minimum_payment_due and rewards_balance all reconcile to the seeded ledger.
card_transactions purchases (12) and their rewards earn rows (12): the six purchases inside the last six months total 7,172.15 and decide two rounding and ordering ladders; the six older ones, including the 8,400.00 cruise, give the account its balance and are excluded by the window.
card_transactions payments (16): the twelve inside twelve months decide three share ladders; the four older ones are excluded by the window, and one of them is the payment the 2025-02-19 return reverses.
card_transactions interest (9): six inside the six-month window total 364.07 and drive the interest relief and the carryover tier; the 2025-11-12 charge is the boundary distractor; the two earliest give the account a credible revolving history.
card_transactions fees (4): the late payment fee of 2026-05-12 and the cash advance fee of 2026-04-28 make up the two-month fee total the proportion base uses and the late fee also lights the carryover tier; the annual fee of 2025-09-12 is correctly billed in the anniversary month and sits outside the two-month window; the returned payment fee of 2025-02-19 is correctly paired with its return and sits outside the twelve-month window the rebilled share tests.
card_transactions merchant credits (2): both inside six months, they are exactly what the merchant-offset ladder sets off.
card_transactions dispute credits (2): the 218.00 of 2024-11-20 belongs to the dispute resolved in the cardholder's favour and is the evidence row for the one-credit dedup gate; the 640.00 of 2025-12-03 belongs to the dispute resolved against him and is the object the rebill names. Remove the second and the second prerequisite lapses.
card_disputes (3): the submitted one makes the first prerequisite false and supplies the claimed amount; the resolved-against one makes the second false and supplies the amount at risk; the resolved-in-favour one is what takes the twenty-four-month count above the uplift threshold.
checking_accounts and checking_transactions (6): the Premier tier decides two share ladders and the six payroll deposits totalling 14,760.00 decide three method ladders. The ledger deliberately carries no checking fee of any kind, because Premier Checking's relationship-balance waiver is met at every cycle close for this customer and the checking charter assesses no monthly maintenance fee where a waiver is met.
savings_accounts and savings_transactions (5): the 46,215.80 balance is the first limb of three ladders; the withdrawal of 2026-04-08 is the second limb of the merchant-offset ladder; the three deposits of 2025-12-15, 2026-03-15 and 2026-05-15 are the credited certificate payouts and the second limb of two more ladders; the interest credit keeps the account honest.
cd_certificates and cd_transactions (4): the 25,000.00 principal is the first limb of three ladders; the three interest payouts are the second limb of the two rounding ladders and are mirrored as savings deposits because the certificate pays its interest to savings.
Automatic-clause check: days_past_due is 0, so neither suspension at 60 days nor charge-off at 180 fires. The annual fee is already billed for the current account year and the next falls due in September. military_status is none, so no military rate cap and no penalty APR. Interest bills only at statement close, and the most recent close is seeded. The certificate matures 2027-09-15, well after the frozen date, so no maturity or grace clause fires. No seeded row lights an obligation this task set does not carry, and no cache field is used as a trap: current_balance agrees with the ledger and the computation reconciles the ledger anyway.

PERSONA
Roland is written as an unhurried shift worker who has been putting this off, which explains both why he calls and why he will not name a figure. His refusal to choose between the statement balance, the minimum and a number of his own closes the only question that could otherwise let the agent pick, and his single checking account closes the paying-account question without making him recite an internal id. He gives credentials one at a time in a fixed order, so the verification path is definite. His one reaction to the two adjustments - "all right, whatever the record says" - fires only on an agent utterance, names nothing, and would never occur if the agent never found them. He asks for nothing after the confirmation, so his arc ends exactly where evaluation_criteria ends.

REACHABILITY IN ONE CONVERSATION
He states the goal and his name; the agent locates him by mobile number and name; he gives date of birth, SSN last four and ZIP as asked; the agent reads the card account, the card ledger, the dispute list, the checking account and ledger, the savings account and ledger and the certificate and its ledger - all share tools callable by name with arguments already reachable; the agent computes and posts the temporary credit, then the rebill; the agent computes the fixed sum on the ledger those writes leave, unlocks the instruction, hands it over and he runs it; he reads the confirmation back and the call ends. Every question a real agent would ask has a written answer: which account pays, what kind of autopay, whether he has a figure, what else he holds, how he has been paying. Nothing waits on anything outside the environment; all three writes land at 2026-05-21 14:05:00 EDT.

Every declared factor moves its result; all three whole baselines differ from gold; both edges bear weight. These figures are copied unchanged into computations.expected, baseline_result, factor_sensitivity, order_uniqueness and edge_load_bearing.

RULE / COMPUTE TWO-WAY SWEEP
Forward: every binding of all three policies that reads the world or makes a choice carries a verbatim rule quotation in compute_basis - the selections on card_disputes by status and notice date, the fee, interest, purchase, payment, merchant-credit and dispute-count aggregations with their windows, the cross-category reads on checking, savings and the certificate, every ladder binding, every rounding binding, the ceilings and the floor. Reverse: reading each rule through, its load-bearing sentences are the object selection, the three or four ladders with three tiers each, the ordering and grouping clauses, the ceiling and floor clauses and the rounding clauses, and each is implemented by exactly one binding. Sensitive-word cross-check: "in the last two / three / six / twelve / twenty-four months" each correspond to a within_months argument; "ever billed" on the largest single interest charge corresponds to MAX, which takes no window, and the rule says so rather than promising a window the expression does not carry; "never less than zero" to MX; "the lesser of" and "the ceiling ... is compared with" to MN; "rounded half-up to the cent" to RND(x, 2); "rounded half-up to the nearest whole dollar" to RND(x, 0); "reduced to the whole dollar below it" to float(int(x)); "added together" to SUM; "the largest single" to MAX; "the most recent" to LATEST. The order and grouping choices are written out in full in prose - the proportion base, the moment of the ceiling relative to the interest relief, and whether the carryover addition enters before or after the spread - so no reader is left to guess.

SOLVABILITY EVIDENCE AGAINST GOLD
Step 12 declares all three gates of card_evt_billing_disputes applying to a temporary credit, with pre-action system evidence correlated to the call's own arguments: both correlation fields of the notice window bound to source_item_id, the dispute id bound to card_dispute_id for the status gate and the dedup gate. Step 14 declares rebill_needs_liability with the dispute row and its status. Step 16 declares autopay_source with the checking account row, its owner and its status, bound to autopay_source_account_id. temporal_feasibility carries the one time gate, deep-copying the base contract and giving the failing and passing boundary dates. The state fact of steps 12 and 14 is created by the calls themselves; the state fact of step 16 cites prior_step:12 and prior_step:14. No status registration stands in for a real-world event and no persona line is used as authority for an internal fact.

DRAFT RECOMPUTATION FROM THE VISIBLE CONTEXT
Masking the extended yaml, compute, expected, gold and this dossier: the caller wants a fixed monthly autopay. The autopay rule says the fixed amount is settled only after every submitted dispute carries its temporary credit entry, and only once no temporary credit remains outstanding on a dispute resolved against the cardholder. The dispute lookup shows three disputes; the ledger shows two dispute credits and no rebill; so one submitted dispute has no credit and one resolved-against dispute still carries one. The only rule producing a temporary credit is the provisional credit rule: 1,284.00 claimed, plus 54.50 of fees in the last two months because deposits clear 12,000 with no checking fee on the ledger at all, times 0.95 for Premier plus twelve payments, less 310.50 of merchant credits because the money market balance clears 25,000 with a withdrawal inside three months, plus 15.00 because three disputes stand inside twenty-four months, rounded to the dollar because the certificate clears 10,000 with payouts inside six months: 976.00. The only rule producing a rebill is the recovery rule: 640.00 at risk, share 1.00, relief 364.07 of six-month interest, relief first then the ceiling, rounded to the dollar: 276.00. Post both. Then the payable balance is 7,407.92; plus 66.37 of last-month interest gives 7,474.29; times 0.90 gives 6,726.861; plus 45.00 carryover because a late fee and 364.07 of interest fall inside six months, added before the spread because the account is seasoned and purchases clear 4,000; over six cycles gives 1,128.6435; rounded to the dollar, 1,129.00, below the payable balance. Both prerequisite figures and the scored figure agree with gold, and no second reading of the visible text produces a different object, order or value.

user_scenario:
Roland Teasdale is fifty-three, a maintenance supervisor at the regional hospital in Burlington who works rotating shifts and has come to distrust his own memory for dates. He rings the Care Center on his afternoon off, unhurried and a little sheepish, and gets to the point after one sentence of small talk about the weather: "I keep meaning to do this and never do - I want to set up an automatic payment on this card for a fixed amount every month, so I stop having to think about it."

He is emphatic that he does not want the whole statement balance taken and he does not want the bare minimum either; he wants a sensible fixed figure and he says openly that he has no idea what it ought to be. "You work out what it should be," he says, "you people can see the whole picture better than I can." He is content for the money to come out of his Piedmont Crescent checking account - he only has the one, the account his hospital pay goes into - and if the agent asks which account to use he confirms that is the one and that he does not want it coming from anywhere else. He will not accept a figure he has to choose between options for; if he is offered a choice he repeats that he would rather the bank apply its own rule.

Because the instruction is his own, he expects to be the one to put it in place: if the agent explains that he has to run it himself, he says that is fine and does it as soon as it is handed to him, then reads the confirmation back word for word.

He introduces himself as Roland Teasdale and gives his mobile number as 3365550487 when asked how to pull up his record. If he is asked to prove who he is he starts with his date of birth, 1972-11-08, and adds the last four of his social, 1462, and the ZIP at home, 27215, one at a time as each is asked for and not before. He does not offer his email address unless asked, and gives it as roland.teasdale@carolinamail.com.

If the agent asks about anything else he holds at the bank he says he has the checking account, a money market account and a certificate, and that he could not tell you the balances without looking. If the agent asks about his statements or how he has been paying, he says he pays online whenever he remembers, which is why he is calling. Whenever the agent tells him that an adjustment has gone onto the card, whether it puts money on or takes money off, he says only "all right, whatever the record says" and lets it pass without asking what it was for. Once the instruction is in place and he has read the confirmation back, he says that is one more thing off his list, thanks the agent and hangs up; he asks for nothing else and does not want anything sent to him.
